## Objective

Fix a current, reviewable baseline and resolve the native prerequisite before dependent delivery.

## Scope

- Current project and source inspection
- Separately authorized native feasibility prerequisite
- Reviewed storage, role and adoption contracts

## Entry conditions

- Plan preparation itself authorizes no execution; any prerequisite native investigation has a separate bounded user authorization.

## Exit criteria

- Native feasibility has adequate evidence; the resulting canonical plan revision is approved and remaining implementation is separately authorized.
- Exact preservation, authority and design contracts are reviewable.

## Risks

- Native capability uncertainty blocks readiness and downstream work; no topology substitute is permitted.

## TASK-002 - Establish native feasibility before committing to delivery

Perform the separately authorized bounded capability investigation in a disposable context, using only documented native tools and a reviewed minimal problem packet.

| Status | `completed` |

| Dependencies | TASK-001 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-08T06:55:12.366699Z |

### Risks

- Full-history forks can leak an earlier candidate into a queued solver; a prompt request to ignore it is insufficient.
- An idle child may still consume capacity; do not infer slot reclamation from its final message.

### Acceptance criteria

- Evidence establishes or explicitly blocks host-to-manager and manager-to-worker delegation, messaging, role loading, and supported depth.
- Model and reasoning equality has native identity evidence or a named verified effective inheritance guarantee, separately from context isolation.
- A queued candidate probe excludes earlier sibling drafts; capacity accounting, release/reuse, interruption, and reconnect behavior are observed.
- The probe changes no production Task, role, user configuration, registry, or source contract. Any insufficient guarantee blocks readiness and dependent work.

### Planned verification

- Compare effective allowed runtime settings and tool schemas with current OpenAI documentation; record available evidence without exposing configuration secrets.
- Use real native IDs and sent packet hashes for a minimal nested and queued probe; inspect actual contexts or a verified runtime context contract, returned receipts, and stopped assignments.
- Record the result for each capability as passed, failed, blocked, or not exercised; revise the plan baseline only after the authorized probe.
